info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Footwear Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Footwear Recliner Detail Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed information about footwear recliners in the catalog. This endpoint supports the submission of new recliner details, facilitating the addition of product specifications, features, and images. Retailers and e-commerce platforms can utilize this API to enhance their product offerings, ensuring customers have access to comprehensive and accurate product information. This integration streamlines inventory updates and improves customer experiences by providing up-to-date recliner details.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details for a footwear recliner. It accepts specific information about the recliner to ensure accurate representation and availability in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details for creating a footwear recliner. The provided data should conform to the specified schema to ensure accurate processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning footwear recliner details.
